title: Church Unity
definition: Church Unity is the Spirit-given oneness of believers in Christ that must be guarded through truth, humility, love, and peace.
summary: Church Unity is the Gospel-created oneness believers are called to guard through humility, truth, patience, and love.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reconciles believers to God and to one another, making one new people by His cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on shared allegiance to Christ despite different personalities and preferences. Unity is not pretending differences do not exist; it is refusing to let pride, suspicion, or secondary matters tear apart what Christ has joined. It must be protected because sin easily turns preference into division.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because division damages witness and exhausts the saints. Unity shows that the cross reconciles real sinners into one family. It also teaches believers to fight for peace without sacrificing truth.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue reconciliation early when offense appears. Speak about other believers in ways that protect peace and truth. Lay down preferences that do not need to become battlegrounds.
